title: Kissed Earthy Moroccan Fava Beans Bissara
description: Earthy and chewy Moroccan dish featuring nuts, this festive Bissara is a gluten-free friendly option, made with fava beans and spices, and finished with an ice bath shock to stop cooking
instructions: Rinse the fava beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight
Drain and rinse the fava beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover them
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 45 minutes, or until the beans are tender
Drain the fava beans and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop cooking
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened
Add the minced garlic, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the chopped almonds and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Add the cooked fava beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the Bissara and serve hot
